statement: For every integer k >= 3, f(k-1,k) = k+3 under the common-outside-vertex and common-tournament quantifiers frozen in source.md. The proof also establishes the required structural lemma: for every tournament T on V with |V| = n >= 3, define ab to be an edge of H_T exactly when a beats every vertex of V other than a,b or b beats every vertex of V other than a,b; then H_T is contained in a star or is exactly a triangle.
contribution: A self-contained elementary proof of the uniform lower bound at both possible smaller orders, including repeated star centers and all boundary cases, together with an explicit independent k+3-vertex construction. The cited source already supplied an upper-bound mechanism and small SAT values; this claim makes no assertion of publication priority or of being a source-listed open problem.
